function.name: _codestudio_create_api
function.description: Register or update an API for this AICodeStudio module (expose a script function as an HTTP endpoint for the frontend callApi). The backend auto-applies the ai/{moduleId}/ path prefix and files it under the module group — you only give subPath. The same moduleId + subPath updates the existing path and returns the original id; do not create list2 / create_new paths to bypass duplicates. Multiple APIs can reuse one scriptId, differentiated by scriptFunc.

subPath.description: Path suffix (without prefix), e.g. orders/list. Backend forms ai/{moduleId}/orders/list. Later changes for the same business endpoint must keep the same subPath.

scriptFunc.description: Exported function name in the script (must exist).

ownerAppId.description: For cross-app: pass the dashboard app's appId (the script/API is created in the source app you routed to via --appId, but its prefix/group still belongs to the dashboard module). Do NOT pass when reading the current app's data.
